questions.question: {If } cot A = (3)/(4), { then find the value of } 3 sin2 A - cos3 A { is:}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

cot A = 3/4 ⇒ tan A = 4/3 ⇒ triangle: opposite = 4, adjacent = 3, hypotenuse = 5

sin A = 4/5, cos A = 3/5

sin2A = 2 × sinA × cosA = 2 × 4/5 × 3/5 = 24/25

cos3A = 4cos³A − 3cosA = 4 × (3/5)³ − 3 × 3/5 = 108/125 − 9/5 = −117/125

⇒ 3(24/25) - (- 117/125)

⇒ 477/125

**∴ Answer = 477/125**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

cot A = 3/4

**Formula used:**

sin2A = 2sinA cosA

cos3A = 4cos³A − 3cosA

 
 A B C 3 4 5 

**Calculations:**

⇒ cot A = adjacent/opposite = 3/4

⇒ sin A = 4/5, cos A = 3/5

⇒ sin2A = 2 × 4/5 × 3/5 = 24/25

⇒ cos3A = 4 × (3/5)³ − 3 × 3/5

⇒ = 108/125 − 9/5 = 108/125 − 225/125 = −117/125

⇒ 3sin2A − cos3A = 3 × 24/25 − (−117/125)

⇒ = 72/25 + 117/125 = 360/125 + 117/125 = 477/125

**∴ The correct answer is 477/125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

sin2A Formula

sin2A = 2sinA cosA, useful when sinA and cosA are known.

cos3A Identity

cos3A = 4cos³A − 3cosA, commonly used in higher trig expressions.

Right Triangle Approach

Convert ratios like cot into triangle sides to easily get sin and cos.

Alternative Identity

cos3A can also be written as 4cos³A − 3cosA or 1 − 4sin²A cosA depending on need.

questions.question: Simplify: 3 × 2 + 12 ÷ (6 − 2) × 2
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply BODMAS rule hierarchy: (Bracket) → (Division & Multiplication left-to-right) → (Addition).

Part 1: 3 × 2 = 6.

Part 2: 12 ÷ (6 − 2) × 2 = 12 ÷ 4 × 2 = 3 × 2 = 6.

Final Addition: 6 + 6 = 12.

**∴ Answer = 12**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: 3 × 2 + 12 ÷ (6 − 2) × 2

**Formula used:**

BODMAS Rule: B (Brackets), O (Of), D (Division), M (Multiplication), A (Addition), S (Subtraction). Division and Multiplication are performed from left to right based on their appearance.

 Term 1: 3 × 2 = 6 Term 2: 12 ÷ 4 × 2 = 6 
• Final Result: 6 + 6 = 12 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3 × 2 + 12 ÷ (6 − 2) × 2

⇒ 3 × 2 + 12 ÷ 4 × 2 (Solving Bracket)

⇒ 6 + 3 × 2 (Solving Division and first Multiplication)

⇒ 6 + 6 (Solving second Multiplication)

⇒ 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 (Option 2).**

questions.question: In a ΔMNR, the sides MN and MR are extended to P and Q, respectively. The bisectors of ∠ PNR and ∠ QRN intersect at a point X. If angle X = 75°, then the value of 2 ∠M is:
questions.solution:
Angle formed by external bisectors intersection: ∠X = 90° − ∠M / 2

⇒ 75° = 90° − ∠M / 2

⇒ ∠M / 2 = 90° − 75° = 15°

⇒ ∠M = 30° ⇒ 2 × ∠M = 60°

**∴ Answer = 60°**

**Given:**

In triangle MNR, sides MN and MR are extended to P and Q. Bisectors of exterior angles ∠PNR and ∠QRN meet at X. Angle ∠X = 75°.

**Formula used:**

Angle at intersection of external bisectors = 90° − (Internal opposite angle / 2)

 
 
•

• M N R P Q X = 75° ∠X = 90° − ∠M/2 

**Calculations:**

∠X = 90° − ∠M/2

⇒ 75° = 90° − ∠M/2

⇒ ∠M/2 = 90° − 75°

⇒ ∠M/2 = 15°

⇒ ∠M = 15° × 2 = 30°

⇒ 2∠M = 2 × 30° = 60°

questions.question: To buy a car, Taniya borrowed ₹75,000 at 8% per annum simple interest for 27 months. How much interest will she pay?

Total Interest Rate % = 8% × (27/12) = 18%

Simple Interest = 18% of 75,000

Simple Interest = 18 × 750 = 13,500

**∴ Answer = ₹13,500**

Rate (R) = 8% per annum

 Simple Interest Timeline 
• 
•

 Total Interest = ₹13,500 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time (T) = 27 / 12 years

⇒ T = 9 / 4 = 2.25 years

⇒ SI = (75,000 × 8 × 2.25) / 100

⇒ SI = 750 × 8 × 2.25

questions.question: A dealer marks his goods at 80% above the cost price and allows a discount of 5% on the marked price. What is his gain or loss percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Profit % = x + y + (xy / 100)

Here, Markup (x) = +80 and Discount (y) = −5

Net Profit % = 80 − 5 + [80 × (−5) / 100]

Net Profit % = 75 − 400/100 = 75 − 4 = 71%

**∴ Answer = 71% gain**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Markup % = 80%, Discount % = 5%

**Formula used:**

MP = CP × (100 + Markup %)/100; SP = MP × (100 − Discount %)/100; Profit % = (SP − CP)/CP × 100

 
• 
• 
• CP = 100 MP = 180 SP = 171 
 Markup +80% 
 −5% Discount Net Profit = 71% 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Cost Price (CP) = 100 units

⇒ Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 80% of 100 = 180 units

⇒ Discount = 5% of 180 = (5 × 180) / 100 = 9 units

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount = 180 − 9 = 171 units

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 171 − 100 = 71 units

⇒ Profit % = (71 / 100) × 100 = 71%

**∴ The correct answer is (2).**

questions.question: Determine the largest number that divides both 1058 and 1550, leaving remainders of 5 and 11, respectively.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required Number = HCF of (1058 − 5) and (1550 − 11) = HCF(1053, 1539).

Both numbers are odd, so eliminate even options 86 and 88.

Calculate difference: 1539 − 1053 = 486.

The HCF must be a factor of the difference; 81 × 6 = 486.

Testing 81: 1053 ÷ 81 = 13 and 1539 ÷ 81 = 19 (both integers).

**∴ Answer = 81**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number = 1058, Remainder₁ = 5

Second number = 1550, Remainder₂ = 11

**Formula used:**

Largest number dividing N₁ and N₂ leaving remainders R₁ and R₂ = HCF(N₁ − R₁, N₂ − R₂)

 1053 (Multiple of 81) 
• 
• 81 81 ... 13 times 1539 (Multiple of 81) 
• 
• 81 81 ... 19 times Common Divisor (HCF) = 81 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First number for HCF = 1058 − 5 = 1053

⇒ Second number for HCF = 1550 − 11 = 1539

⇒ Applying Long Division for HCF:

⇒ 1539 = 1 × 1053 + 486

⇒ 1053 = 2 × 486 + 81

⇒ 486 = 6 × 81 + 0

⇒ The last divisor that gives remainder 0 is the HCF.

⇒ HCF(1053, 1539) = 81

**∴ The correct answer is 81.**

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are 146 cm, 96 cm, and 110 cm. What is its area (in cm²)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divide sides by 2 to check for triplets: 146/2 = 73, 96/2 = 48, 110/2 = 55.

Since 48² + 55² = 2304 + 3025 = 5329 = 73², it is a right-angled triangle.

Area = 1/2 × base × height = 1/2 × 96 × 110.

Area = 48 × 110 = 5280 cm².

**∴ Answer = 5280**

**Given:**

Sides of the triangle: a = 146 cm, b = 96 cm, c = 110 cm

**Formula used:**

Heron's Formula: Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)], where s = (a + b + c) / 2

 
 
• 
• Base (b) = 96 cm Height (c) = 110 cm Hypotenuse (a) = 146 cm Area = 1/2 × 96 × 110 

**Calculations:**

Calculate semi-perimeter (s):

⇒ s = (146 + 96 + 110) / 2 = 352 / 2 = 176 cm

Apply Heron's formula:

⇒ Area = √[176 × (176 − 146) × (176 − 96) × (176 − 110)]

⇒ Area = √[176 × 30 × 80 × 66]

⇒ Area = √[(11 × 16) × (3 × 10) × (8 × 10) × (6 × 11)]

⇒ Area = √[11² × 10² × 16 × (3 × 8 × 6)]

⇒ Area = √[11² × 10² × 16 × 144]

⇒ Area = 11 × 10 × 4 × 12

⇒ Area = 110 × 48 = 5280 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 5280, which is option (3).**

questions.question:
Walking at (3)/(4) th of his normal speed from his home, Bhavesh is 15 minutes late in reaching his office.

The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio (Usual : New) = 4 : 3

Time ratio (Usual : New) = 3 : 4 [Since Time ∝ 1/Speed]

Difference in time ratio = 4 − 3 = 1 unit

Given 1 unit = 15 minutes, then Usual time = 3 units = 3 × 15 = 45 minutes

**∴ Answer = 45 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

New Speed = 3/4 of Usual Speed

Time Delay = 15 minutes

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time (For constant Distance, Speed₁ × Time₁ = Speed₂ × Time₂)

 
• Home Office 
 Usual Case: Speed S, Time T 
 Late Case: Speed 3/4S, Time T + 15 

**Calculations:**

Let the usual speed be S and usual time be T.

⇒ New Speed = 3/4 S and New Time = T + 15

⇒ S × T = (3/4)S × (T + 15)

⇒ T = 3/4 (T + 15)

⇒ 4T = 3T + 45

⇒ 4T − 3T = 45

⇒ T = 45 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 45 minutes (Option 1).**

questions.question: A person saves 60% of his income. If his expenditure is ₹480, then his income (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Savings = 60% → Expenditure = 100% − 60% = 40%

Unitary Method: 40% → 480

1% → 480 ÷ 40 = 12

Income (100%) → 12 × 100 = 1200

**∴ Answer = 1200**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Savings percentage = 60%

Expenditure amount = ₹480

**Formula used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Expenditure % = 100% − Savings %

 Total Income (100%) 
• Expenditure (40%) = ₹480 
• Savings (60%) Income = 480 ÷ 0.4 = ₹1200 

**Calculations:**

Let the total income be ₹I.

⇒ Expenditure % = 100% − 60% = 40%

⇒ 40% of I = 480

⇒ (40 ÷ 100) × I = 480

⇒ I = (480 × 100) ÷ 40

⇒ I = 12 × 100 = 1200

**∴ The correct answer is 1200 (Option 2).**

questions.question: A class of 95 students took a Physics test. 47 students had an average score of 93. The other students had an average score of 54. What is the average score (rounded off to one decimal place) of the whole class?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume base average = 54.

Deviation for 47 students = 93 − 54 = +39.

Total deviation = 47 × 39 = 1833.

Net average increase = 1833 ÷ 95 ≈ 19.3.

Total Average = 54 + 19.3 = 73.3.

**∴ Answer = 73.3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total students in class = 95

Number of students in first group (n₁) = 47, Average score (A₁) = 93

Number of students in second group (n₂) = 95 − 47 = 48, Average score (A₂) = 54

**Formula used:**

Weighted Average = (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

 48 Students (n₂) 47 Students (n₁) Avg: 54 Avg: 93 
• Total Average = 73.3

**Calculations:**

Sum of scores of 47 students = 47 × 93 = 4371

⇒ Sum of scores of 48 students = 48 × 54 = 2592

⇒ Total sum of scores = 4371 + 2592 = 6963

⇒ Average score of whole class = 6963 ÷ 95

⇒ Average score ≈ 73.2947

⇒ Average score (rounded to 1 decimal place) = 73.3

**∴ The correct answer is 73.3 (Option 1).**

questions.question: If the third proportional of 50 and 30 be x, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Third proportional (x) = b² ÷ a

Here a = 50 and b = 30

x = (30 × 30) ÷ 50

x = 900 ÷ 50

x = 18

**∴ Answer = 18**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First term (a) = 50

Second term (b) = 30

Third proportional = x

**Formula used:**

If a, b, and x are in continued proportion, then a : b = b : x

 50 Term a 
 30 Term b 
 x Third Prop Ratio Relationship: 50 : 30 = 30 : x 
 

**Calculations:**

The numbers 50, 30, and x are in continued proportion.

⇒ 50 ÷ 30 = 30 ÷ x

⇒ 5 ÷ 3 = 30 ÷ x

⇒ 5 × x = 30 × 3

⇒ 5x = 90

⇒ x = 90 ÷ 5

⇒ x = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18 (Option 1).**

Aditya full work time = 13 × 6 = 78 days

Bhagawan full work time = 12 × 9 = 108 days

Combined time = (A × B) / (A + B) = (78 × 108) / (78 + 108)

Combined time = 8424 / 186 = 45.2903...

**∴ Answer = 45.3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Aditya completes 1/6 work in 13 days.

Bhagawan completes 1/9 work in 12 days.

**Formula used:**

Total days to complete work = Total work / Combined efficiency

 
• Aditya (A): 78 days Bhagawan (B): 108 days 
 Combined Work (A + B) Total Work = LCM(78, 108) = 1404 

**Calculations:**

Total time for Aditya = 13 × 6 = 78 days

⇒ Total time for Bhagawan = 12 × 9 = 108 days

⇒ Let Total Work = LCM(78, 108) = 1404 units

⇒ Efficiency of Aditya = 1404 ÷ 78 = 18 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of Bhagawan = 1404 ÷ 108 = 13 units/day

⇒ Total Efficiency = 18 + 13 = 31 units/day

⇒ Combined Time = 1404 ÷ 31 = 45.2903... days

⇒ Rounded to one decimal place = 45.3 days

**∴ The correct answer is 45.3 (Option 2).**

questions.question: A number is first decreased by 35% and then further decreased by 25%. By what percentage has the original number been decreased altogether?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net percentage change formula = a + b + (a × b / 100)

For two successive decreases, a = −35 and b = −25

Net change = −35 − 25 + (−35 × −25 / 100)

Net change = −60 + 8.75 = −51.25%

Overall decrease = 51.25%

**∴ Answer = 51.25**

questions.question:
The points scored by a basket-ball team in a series of matches are as follows:

17, 2, 7, 27, 25, 5, 14, 18, 10, 24, 10, 8, 7, 10.

The value of mode is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the value that appears the maximum number of times in the data.

Scores: 17, 2, 7, 27, 25, 5, 14, 18, 10, 24, 10, 8, 7, 10

Number 10 repeats 3 times (Highest frequency).

Number 7 repeats 2 times.

All other numbers appear only once.

**∴ Answer = 10**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data set: 17, 2, 7, 27, 25, 5, 14, 18, 10, 24, 10, 8, 7, 10

**Formula used:**

Mode = Value with the highest frequency in the distribution.

 
• 
• 2 5 7 8 10 14+ Freq: 3 Freq: 2 Frequency Distribution 

**Calculations:**

Arrange the scores in ascending order to count frequencies easily:

⇒ 2, 5, 7, 7, 8, 10, 10, 10, 14, 17, 18, 24, 25, 27

⇒ Frequency of 2 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 5 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 7 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 8 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 10 = 3

⇒ Frequency of 14, 17, 18, 24, 25, 27 = 1 each

⇒ Since 10 appears the most number of times (3 times), the mode is 10.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 (Option 3).**

questions.question: A number when doubled and increased by 7 becomes 29. Find the number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Perform the reverse operations on the result in reverse order.

Step 1: Subtract the increase (29 − 7 = 22)

Step 2: Divide by the doubling factor (22 ÷ 2 = 11)

**∴ Answer = 11**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Final result = 29

Operations: Number is doubled (2 × x) and increased by 7 (+7)

**Formula used:**

Equation: (2 × x) + 7 = 29

 Initial (x) 
 
 2x + 7 
 
 29 ×2 then +7 
• Value: x = 11 

**Calculations:**

Let the required number be x.

⇒ 2x + 7 = 29

⇒ 2x = 29 − 7

⇒ 2x = 22

⇒ x = 22 ÷ 2

⇒ x = 11

**∴ The correct answer is 11. Option (4).**

questions.question: If A : B = 1 : 3 , B : C = 4 : 3 and C : D = 5 : 7 , then A : B : C : D is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the column multiplication method for compound ratios:

A = 1 × 4 × 5 = 20

B = 3 × 4 × 5 = 60

C = 3 × 3 × 5 = 45

D = 3 × 3 × 7 = 63

**∴ Answer = 20 : 60 : 45 : 63**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A : B = 1 : 3, B : C = 4 : 3, C : D = 5 : 7

**Formula used:**

To combine ratios X : Y and Y : Z, multiply terms to make the common variable Y equal.

 A 20 B 60 C 45 D 63 Combined Ratio = 20 : 60 : 45 : 63 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A : B = 1 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 3

⇒ Equating B: Multiply (A : B) by 4 and (B : C) by 3

⇒ A : B = 4 : 12, B : C = 12 : 9 → A : B : C = 4 : 12 : 9

⇒ Now, A : B : C = 4 : 12 : 9 and C : D = 5 : 7

⇒ Equating C: Multiply (A : B : C) by 5 and (C : D) by 9

⇒ A : B : C = 20 : 60 : 45, C : D = 45 : 63

⇒ A : B : C : D = 20 : 60 : 45 : 63

**∴ The correct answer is Option (4).**

questions.question: A rectangular garden is 50 m long and 40 m wide. A path of uniform width is laid inside the garden along its boundary. If the area of the path is 344 m², find the perimeter of the inner rectangle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Shortcut formula for path area inside: 2w(L + B − 2w) = Area

2w(50 + 40 − 2w) = 344 ⇒ w(90 − 2w) = 172

By inspection, w = 2 satisfies the equation: 2 × (90 − 4) = 172

Inner perimeter = 2 × (L + B − 4w) = 2 × (50 + 40 − 8)

Inner perimeter = 2 × 82 = 164 m

**∴ Answer = 164 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Outer length (L) = 50 m, Outer width (W) = 40 m, Area of path = 344 m²

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = Length × Width

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 × (Length + Width)

 Outer Length = 50 m Outer Width = 40 m Inner Garden 
• w Path Area = 344 m²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of outer garden = 50 × 40 = 2000 m²

⇒ Area of inner garden = Total Area − Path Area = 2000 − 344 = 1656 m²

⇒ Let uniform width of path be x. Inner length = (50 − 2x) and Inner width = (40 − 2x)

⇒ Area of inner garden = (50 − 2x)(40 − 2x) = 1656

⇒ 2000 − 100x − 80x + 4x² = 1656 ⇒ 4x² − 180x + 344 = 0

⇒ Dividing by 4: x² − 45x + 86 = 0 ⇒ (x − 2)(x − 43) = 0

⇒ Width x = 2 m (since width x < 20 m)

⇒ Inner dimensions: Length = 50 − 2(2) = 46 m; Width = 40 − 2(2) = 36 m

⇒ Perimeter of inner rectangle = 2 × (46 + 36) = 2 × 82 = 164 m

**∴ The correct answer is 164 m. (Option 2)**
